prewrittenFacts.statement: Noor went to the library with her father on Saturdays.
They left at nine in the morning and returned before lunch.
Noor borrowed two books: an animal book and a storybook.
The father did not take the newspaper home.
They bought four bread rolls and paid cash.

result.original: Every Saturday, Noor walked to the library with her father. They left home at nine in the morning and returned before lunch. Noor borrowed two books each time: one about animals and one storybook. Her father borrowed a newspaper from the reading desk but did not take it home. On the way back they bought four bread rolls from the bakery next to the bus stop. They paid with cash. The librarian knew their names and kept a small wooden stool beside the children's shelf so Noor could reach the upper row. This routine continued for one summer. There was no special celebration on the last Saturday; they returned the books and took their usual walk home.
